title: angelica laevigata
intro: Angelica laevigata, commonly known as Chinese angelica, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is native to China and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Angelica laevigata include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Angelica laevigata include ferulic acid, ligustilide, and senkyunolide, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as vasodilation, analgesia, and sedation.
